hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_input.notebook_path // empty' | { read -r f; if [ -z "$f" ]; then exit 0; fi; case "$f" in */migrations/*|migrations/*) printf '%s' '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"Écriture interdite dans le dossier migrations/ (protégé par hook)."}}' ;; esac; }

jq -r '.tool_response.filePath // .tool_input.file_path // empty' | { read -r f; if [ -z "$f" ]; then exit 0; fi; case "$f" in *.js|*.jsx|*.ts|*.tsx|*.mjs|*.cjs) : ;; *) exit 0;; esac; ESLINT=""; if [ -x "./node_modules/.bin/eslint" ]; then ESLINT="./node_modules/.bin/eslint"; elif command -v eslint >/dev/null 2>&1; then ESLINT="eslint"; else exit 0; fi; OUT=$("$ESLINT" "$f" --no-color 2>&1); if [ -n "$OUT" ]; then printf '%s' "{\"decision\":\"block\",\"reason\":$(printf '%s' "$OUT" | jq -Rs .)}"; fi; }
